title: Torque-converter clutch stuck on
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM detected behavior consistent with the torque-converter clutch remaining applied after it was commanded off.
failureCriteria: The reproduced chart expects clutch slip speed to increase after the off command; exact timing and slip limits are not yet verified.
driverSymptoms: The engine may stall as the vehicle stops if the clutch remains mechanically applied.

likelyCauses.cause: Torque-converter clutch apply circuit remains pressurized
TCC solenoid or valve does not release correctly

falsePositiveConditions: A speed-signal error can make calculated clutch slip misleading.
confirmatoryTests: Confirm that the PCM commands the clutch off.
Observe whether engine-to-transmission slip increases after the off command.
Check the TCC electrical and hydraulic release circuits.
safetyLevel: Use caution; a truly stuck clutch can stall the engine when stopping
